description: This file defines a class extending SugarView to display a map with a quick radius display feature, generating a dynamic iframe based on request parameters.

classes.name: Jjwg_MapsViewQuick_Radius_Display
classes.description: A view class for rendering a map iframe with dynamic URL based on request parameters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates a URL with request parameters and outputs an iframe embedding the map, also displays a link to the URL.
